questions.question: When Jesus told His disciples to feed a large crowd in a desolate place, how much food did they have?

answers.text: Seven loaves and a few fish

questions.question: Before Jesus fed a crowd of about five thousand men, what did He tell His disciples to have the people do?

answers.text: Sit down in groups of about fifty
Stand in lines of about a hundred
Walk to the nearest village together
